step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor extracted from an RF front-end circuit. Depending on the surrounding passive components, it can act as a common-source amplifier stage or an RF switch.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz-Band 1.8-V Operation Single-Chip Si-CMOS T/R-MMIC Front-End with a Low Insertion Loss Switch

dc_current.description: DC drain current of the transistor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model with SKY130 parameters.
Based on expected DC current and 1.8V supply.

ac_gain.description: Low frequency AC voltage gain with 10kOhm load

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov = 1.29 mS. ro = 1/(lambda*Id) = 32 kOhm. Rout = 10k || 32k = 7.6 kOhm. Av = gm * Rout = 9.8 V/V = 19.8 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using small-signal parameters with a 10kOhm load resistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at output: f_3dB = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cout). With Cout ~ 15fF (parasitics + load), f_3dB ~ 1.4 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant at the output node.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for single NMOS transistor configured as a common-source amplifier with a 10kOhm load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Single NMOS Transistor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Testbench components
VDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
RL VDD N0 10k
CL N0 0 10f

.control
* DC Operating Point Analysis
op
let id = -i(VDD)
let power = id * 1.8
print id power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(N0)
meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=10k
let target_gain = $&low_freq_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=target_gain fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
